recognize_zh: 這是試管的肉眼照片而非顯微鏡圖：離心後試管底部的液體呈不透明、乳白偏淡粉紅色，透光性差，表示液體中有大量散射光線的脂蛋白顆粒（乳糜微粒/VLDL），對應三酸甘油脂高達 1500 mg/dL 的乳糜狀檢體。
features: Gross photograph of a glass tube held horizontally over gauze
Fluid in the tube is opaque, creamy white with a pale pink-orange tinge rather than clear straw-colored
Poor light transmission through the fluid, indicating turbidity
No distinct cream layer or cell pellet can be resolved at this angle and resolution
describe_en: This is a non-morphologic gross photograph of a centrifuged specimen in a glass tube. The supernatant is opaque and creamy (lactescent) with a faint pink tinge instead of being clear, although a separate floating cream layer cannot be resolved at this angle. Marked plasma turbidity of this kind indicates high concentrations of light-scattering triglyceride-rich lipoproteins, correlating with the reported triglyceride level of 1500 mg/dL. Findings are consistent with lipemia due to severe hypertriglyceridemia, which can interfere with automated hematology and chemistry assays and clog extracorporeal circuits.

ddx.dx: Chylous effusion or chylomicronemia (type I hyperlipoproteinemia)
ddx.vs: Chylomicrons float as a creamy top layer after overnight refrigeration with a clear infranatant, whereas VLDL excess (type IV) leaves diffusely turbid plasma.
Hemolysis gives a transparent red-pink supernatant from free hemoglobin rather than an opaque milky one.

ddx.dx: Propofol or intravenous lipid emulsion infusion
ddx.vs: Exogenous lipid produces similar lactescence, so drug and nutrition history and repeat sampling after stopping infusion are needed.
Cryoglobulins precipitate as a gel or white sediment in the cold that redissolves at 37 C, with normal triglyceride levels.
